meta.title: Delete & Disable Comments demo
meta.description: Demo site with sample comments, spam, pingbacks and editor Notes.
meta.author: helpstring

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$post_id = wp_insert_post(array(
	'post_title'     => 'Ten years of blog comments',
	'post_content'   => 'Sample post for the Delete & Disable Comments preview. All comments on this demo site are generated.',
	'post_status'    => 'publish',
	'comment_status' => 'open',
	'ping_status'    => 'open',
));
$readers = array('Anna', 'Ben', 'Clara', 'David', 'Eva', 'Felix', 'Greta', 'Hugo');

for ($i = 1; $i <= 240; $i++) {
	wp_insert_comment(array(
		'comment_post_ID'      => $post_id,
		'comment_author'       => $readers[$i % count($readers)],
		'comment_author_email' => 'reader' . $i . '@example.com',
		'comment_content'      => 'Sample reader comment number ' . $i . '.',
		'comment_approved'     => 0 === $i % 6 ? '0' : '1',
	));
}
for ($i = 1; $i <= 160; $i++) {
	wp_insert_comment(array(
		'comment_post_ID'      => $post_id,
		'comment_author'       => 'Cheap followers ' . $i,
		'comment_author_email' => 'spam' . $i . '@example.invalid',
		'comment_author_url'   => 'https://spam.example.invalid/' . $i,
		'comment_content'      => 'Buy cheap followers now! Visit my site, offer ' . $i . '.',
		'comment_approved'     => 'spam',
	));
}
for ($i = 1; $i <= 12; $i++) {
	wp_insert_comment(array(
		'comment_post_ID'  => $post_id,
		'comment_author'   => 'Example Blog ' . $i,
		'comment_content'  => 'Pingback from an example blog post.',
		'comment_type'     => 'pingback',
		'comment_approved' => '1',
	));
}
for ($i = 1; $i <= 3; $i++) {
	wp_insert_comment(array(
		'comment_post_ID'  => $post_id,
		'user_id'          => 1,
		'comment_author'   => 'admin',
		'comment_content'  => 'Editor note ' . $i . ': these stay protected unless you select them.',
		'comment_type'     => 'note',
		'comment_approved' => '1',
	));
}
